The 30 September digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted ticket #8841 for Door 14 at Newark. Drivers on the second shift couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

That one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and kiosk cache issue. Either the number was reused or one of the two sources has it wrong. I only have the digest to go on, so please confirm #8841 in the support system.
